query:
SELECT product, milestone_name, milestone_type, DATE(milestone_date) as date 
FROM milestones 
WHERE milestone_name LIKE '%GTM%' OR milestone_name LIKE '%Go-to-Market%' OR milestone_name LIKE '%Market%'
LIMIT 20;
